RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 23, 2008/Pausa 2, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister;  Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture;
Finance; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
103
New insurance policies sold by
insurance companies
*301. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA:  Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of new insurance policies
sold year-wise by the life, general and
medical insurers during the last five years,
indicating the numbers, volume of premium
deposited and volume of redemption
involved in respective categories;
(b) the details of insurance policies
renewed out of them and premium received;
(c) the details of life insurance policies
lapsed over the last five years due to default
by policy holders indicating their number
and volume of fund lying locked on account
of lapsed policies with Life Insurance
Corporation (LIC) and other insurance
companies; and
(d) the extant policy of Government
for utilisation of this locked insurance
fund?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Installation of modern air traffic
system at airports
†*302. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the airports where modern air traffic
system has been installed during the last
three years;
(b) the details of expenditure made by
Government in this regard;
(c) the details of benefits accrued to the
aviation sector as a result of it;
(d) the airports which have been enabled
for chartered flights during the said period;
(e) the names of places where
Monopulse Secondary Surveillance Radars
(MSSR) have been installed or proposed
to be installed; and
(f) the details of expenditure incurred
on these radars and the details of benefits
of installing MSSR?

104
Declaration of Ganga as National River
†*303. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS :
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken by
Government to give practical shape to the
declaration of the Ganga as the National
River;
(b) whether there is also a proposal to
stop some ongoing projects; and
(c) the measures being initiated to get
public cooperation in order to make this
plan successful?
Impact of terrorism on tourist arrival
in India
*304. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
DR. V . MAITREYAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the present level of tourist
arrivals in the country;
(b) what is the corresponding figures
during the last year;
(c) whether the arrival of tourists has
been severely affected due to the security
problem in the country on account of
terrorists activities in the country; and
(d) what serious measures are being
contemplated to improve the security in
the country to facilitate the tourist arrivals
in the country?
Upgradation of refineries
*305. SHRI  MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the public sector oil
companies propose to upgrade their
refineries and to equip them to process high
sulphur crude oil to cut their import bill;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the existing refining capacity of each
of the refineries of the public sector oil
companies and whether these capacities
have been fully utilised in the last few years;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pay disparity among Group ‘B’
Officers of various Ministries/
Departments
*306. SHRI  PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL :  Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Sixth
Pay Commission has not looked into just
demand of Group ‘B’ Officers of
Information and Broadcasting (I&B)
Ministry of granting them Group ‘A’ scale
after completion of four years of service;
(b) whether it is also a fact that officers
for the Railways, Accounts, Central
Secretariat Service (CSS), Central
Secretariat Stenographers Service (CSSS),
Delhi, Andaman and Nicobar Islands Civil
Service (DANICS) and Delhi, Andaman and
Nicobar Islands Police Service (DANIPS)
have been given better deal; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve career prospects of Group ‘B’
Officers of I&B Ministry?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

105
Social obligations of private sector oil
companies
*307. SHRI  DARA SINGH:
SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the present contribution of
producers in private sector oil Companies
in meeting their social obligations; and
(b) whether Government has not made
it obligatory by asking them to supply
petroleum products to Government
companies on Indian market prices before
allowing them to export the same on a very
high profit?
Scarcity of water
†*308. SHRI  BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI:
SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
scarcity of water
